The '''University corpus''' is a small, sourced, neutral knowledge base about
the university as an institution. Each page is definitional and cited; no
specific institutions are ranked or enumerated. The corpus is designed to grow —
further sourced concept pages can be added under the same categories.

== Concept pages ==

* [[University]] — what a university is (definition, etymology, mission).
* [[History of the university]] — the ''studium generale'' and medieval origins.
* [[University governance]] — autonomy, academic freedom, shared governance.
* [[Academic degree]] — bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels.

== Scope and conventions ==

* '''Definitional, not promotional.''' Pages state only what sourced references
  establish about the concept.
* '''Cited.''' Every substantive claim carries a <code><ref></code> to an
  authoritative source (UNESCO, Encyclopædia Britannica, AAUP/AAU, Cambridge,
  and encyclopaedic references). Source text is paraphrased, not copied.
* '''Self-hosted.''' This is MediaWiki markup for a private/self-hosted wiki. It
  is not a submission to any public encyclopedia, whose policies on notability,
  independent sourcing and auto-generated content govern what may be published
  there.
